policy: Approved product-based projects in one personal Azure organization: Concertable and TjAgents each share a project/default-team board across their related repositories. Each independent repository under tomjseery has its own project/board by default. Personal is ownership scope only, never a catch-all project or board. Group further repositories only with established product identity or explicit direction. No queue adoption/cutover until the live pilot and migration-owner coordination; archived repos are mapped without automatic activation.
